text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Huh?
*yaaawn* It's already past noon...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I played ranked matches until dawn.
Heh heh, thanks to that, my rating shot way up.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The day feels so short... That's the penalty for sleeping in past noon, I guess.
Well, I'll accept that. However—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Not feeling sleepy at all is bad news...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Paying the price for staying up late the night before,
Rulership simply couldn't fall asleep...
